# CDL Entry Level Driver Training (ELDT): Class A

> 15-hour online entry-level driver training (theory) for a Class A commercial driver's license, in accordance with FMCSA and DOT regulations in 49 CFR Part 380. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com), listed on the FMCSA Training Provider Registry.

## Key facts
- Regulation: 49 CFR Part 380 (FMCSA ELDT rule, in effect since February 2022)
- Class A: combination vehicles with GCWR of 26,001 lb or more when towing a trailer over 10,000 lb
- Duration: 15 hours; 5 modules, 30 lessons, final exam (80% to pass)
- Credits: 1.5 CEU
- Price: $129.99 per person; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, mobile-friendly, audio playback
- Reporting: completion reported to the FMCSA Training Provider Registry
- Not included: behind-the-wheel training (complete separately if your state requires it)
- State acceptance: every state except Washington (Washington requires classroom instruction by a registered Washington provider)
- Typical prerequisites: age 18+ (21+ for interstate), valid non-commercial driver's license

## Modules
1. Basic Operation of a Commercial Motor Vehicle (7 lessons)
2. Safe Operating Procedures (7 lessons)
3. Advanced Operating Practices (3 lessons)
4. Vehicle Systems and Reporting Malfunctions (3 lessons)
5. Non-Driving Activities (10 lessons: cargo, environmental compliance, hours of service, fatigue, post-crash, communications, whistleblower and coercion, trip planning, drugs and alcohol, medical requirements)
